commits.subject: orm: EngineLockedNextID returned ID=1 when 'select max(ID)' failed
commits.body:
TRestStorageExternal.EngineLockedNextID reset fEngineLockedMaxID to 0 and
then ran 'select max(ID)'; if ExecuteDirect() failed (e.g. MySQL/MariaDB
"server has gone away" or any lost connection), it returned nil and the
counter silently stayed at 0, so the next INSERT used ID=1, then 2, 3...
with a "Duplicate entry for key PRIMARY" error on each, until the next
EngineAddForceSelectMaxID or restart.

Now EngineLockedNextID returns 0 when 'select max(ID)' failed, and keeps
fEngineLockedMaxID=0 so that the select is retried at next call. Its callers
(EngineAdd in BATCH mode, ExecuteFromJson and TOrmVirtualTableExternal.Insert)
report the failure as they already do for any other DB error: returning 0
or false, without executing the INSERT. A void table (max(ID)=NULL) still
returns 1 as before.

New regression test TTestExternalDatabase.NextIDSelectMaxFailure: renames
the external table so that 'select max(ID)' fails, then checks that no ID
is returned, and that max(ID)+1 is used once the table is back. Without
this fix, it returns 1, 2, then 4 instead of 11.
commits.author: Dimitris Kounalakis
